image_description: A close-up portrait of a guenon monkey (likely a Vervet or similar species) perched on a branch. The monkey has a greyish head, a distinctive black face with white fur framing it (facial ruff), and brown eyes. Its body shows brownish-grey fur. The background is a blurred wire mesh fence, indicating an enclosure setting.
